name: Dogecoin
description: Dogecoin is a peer-to-peer digital currency based on the popular doge meme, founded by IBM engineers Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer.
longDescription: The Dogecoin Foundation is a not-for-profit organization dedicated to supporting and advancing the Dogecoin crypto-currency. Established in 2014 by members of the Dogecoin team, the Foundation focuses on development, advocacy, and the defense of the Dogecoin trademark to prevent abuse and fraud. Looking toward the future, the Foundation has created a comprehensive trailmap to guide the growth and evolution of Dogecoin. In 2021, the Foundation has been reinvigorated by both original core team members and new seasoned advisors, all committed to propelling Dogecoin into the next decade. Operating under the names Much Wow Ltd and MadeUpNumbers Ltd in England & Wales, and as Dogecoin Foundation and Much Wow Inc. With a firm foundation and a clear vision, the Dogecoin Foundation is poised to drive the success of Dogecoin as a leading cryptocurrency. Join the ever-growing community and be part of this exciting journey toward a bright future.
